simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to שָׁרִיר (H8306) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: שָׁרִיר (shârîyr) means a cord , i.e. (by analogy) sinew First listed occurrence: Job 40 16.

definitions.full: H8306. sharir [ שָׁרִיר ] noun [masculine] sinew, muscle (so context suggests); — pluralconstruct בִטְנוֺ בִּשְׁרִירֵי אוֺנוֺ Job 40:16 (|| כֹחוֺמְָתְנָיו ).
